_about: SutraFlow silent install: sutraflow install --config install.json [--dry-run]. Passwords are never written here: give {"env": "NAME"} (an environment variable) or {"file": "path"} (a file holding only the password). Remove the _comment fields or leave them; they are ignored.

database._comment: kind: sqlite (a file in the data folder; one server) or postgres (several engines, larger volumes). For sqlite: "kind" and optionally "file" (a file name in the data folder, default sutra.db); SQLite has no users or passwords.
database._pgvector: required (default): the install stops unless pgvector is enabled in the database, enabling it when it is installed on the server; optional: go on without it (knowledge bases then use the built-in store).

server._comment: host 127.0.0.1 keeps the designer and Admin Console on this machine. environment: development, test or production.
server._memory: Node memory of the studio (and of an engine beside it, with enginePort), in MB: 0 = Node.js decides. Each engine is its own process with its own memory; the processes on this machine must leave 15% for the system. Changed later in the Admin Console (Engines, Tuning).
server._names: engineId: this server's engine name (default <machine>-studio); studioMayLead: whether it may lead (default true).
server._workers: Steps at once (2.1.5): studioWorkers for this server, engineWorkers for an engine beside it (with enginePort); 0 or absent = the recommendation for the machine.

cluster._comment: name: the cluster's name, shown in the Admin Console. engines: further engines (PostgreSQL only), each with a settings file beside the installer (sutraflow-engine-<name>.env). canLead false: never the leader (the leader is elected among those that may; at least one must). All of it can be changed later in the Admin Console, Engines.
cluster.name: Production
cluster._timing: heartbeatSeconds: how often engines report in (1 to 60, default 5); drainSeconds: how long a stopping engine lets running steps finish (5 to 3600, default 30). 2.1.5.

_publicUrl: The address people and callers use, behind a proxy or a DNS name (single sign-on, OAuth, links). 2.1.5.
_tls: The gateway certificate (2.1.5). mode: off, selfSigned, uploaded (certFile and keyFile: PEM files on this server) or acme (Let's Encrypt: domains, email, staging, agreeTos).
_samples: true adds the sample Sutras in a project named Samples (none deployed), for designers' machines, training and proofs of concept; keep false for production. Their data is named sample_<objective> and is removed with sutraflow samples remove. An upgrade file takes "samples": "keep" | "add" | "remove" | "refresh". 2.1.5.
